title: Tension magnitude
description: Essential: Correct calculation of tension T = m₁g/cos45° = 20√2 N.

title: Ball acceleration
description: Essential: Correct calculation of acceleration a = g·tan45° = 10 m/s².

title: Wall pressure magnitude
description: Essential: Correct calculation of pressure force F = m₂a = 50 N.

title: Force resolution for ball
description: Important: Proper resolution of tension into vertical (balances weight) and horizontal (causes acceleration) components.

title: Newton's third law application
description: Important: Recognition that wall force on box equals box force on wall in magnitude.

title: Acceleration relationship
description: Important: Understanding that ball and box share the same horizontal acceleration as the cart.

title: Units and symbols
description: Optional: Consistent use of correct units (N, m/s²) and clear notation.

title: Incorrect angle resolution
description: Pitfall: Swapping sin and cos in tension components (e.g., Tsin45° = mg).

title: Missing normal force
description: Pitfall: Forgetting that wall force on box is the only horizontal force causing box acceleration.
